path: Realtek Based Commercial Switch/Commercial Web Managed Switch/STC-18XGDGPW.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Introduction
It has 8*10/100/1000/2500M adaptive electrical ports and 1*10G SFP port enjoying
black iron shell design, internal AC-DC power supply, light weight
high-quality Network and PoE Chip
seamless connection for 10/100/1000/2500M Ethernet
with LED indicators to display the connection and operation of equipment
easy to manage and maintain
without extra configuration
support cloud management
802.3af and 802.3at standard for each PoE port
intelligent detection of powered devices
power the devices that comply with the IEEE802.3af or IEEE802.3at standards
transmit only data to non-PoE devices
It is ideal for high-speed connectivity between WiFi 7 access points, storage servers, and other devices, and can be widely used in security network video surveillance, hotel, campus, small and medium-sized enterprise network engineering and other occasions
Key Features
8* 100/1000/2500Mbps RJ45 ports+1*10G SFP optical port
Complies with IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, IEEE 802.3bz, IEEE 802.3ae, and IEEE 802.3x standards
PoE ports support 100/1000/2500Mbps adaptive
Support PoE priority,default enabled in order from 1 to 8 ports
Supports automatic port flipping (Auto MDI/MDIX)
The panel indicator lights will monitor the working status and assist in fault analysis
Flow control method, IEEE802.3x standard for full duplex and Back pressure standard for half duplex
Support QoS data priority
Support Web Management
Specification
Product Name	9 Port Hybrid Rate Web Managed Ethernet PoE Switch
Port	8*2.5G RJ45 Ports(Support MDI/MDIX, auto-sensing) / 1*10G SFP Port
Switching Capacity	60Gbps
Throughput	44.64Mpps
Packet Buffer	8Mbit
MAC Address	4K
Jumbo Frame	Support
VLAN	VLAN range 1-4094, maximum active VLAN is 31
Transfer Mode	Store and forward
MTBF	100000 hours
Network Protocol	IEEE802.3 (Ethernet) / IEEE802.3u (Fast Ethernet) / IEEE802.3ab (1000Mbps Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3bz (5G Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3z (1000Mbps Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3ae (10 1000Mbps Ethernet) / IEEE802.3x (Flow Control)
Industry Standard	EMI: FCC Part 15, CISPR (EN55032) class A / EMS: EN61000-4-2 (ESD) / EN61000-4-5(Surge)
PoE Protocol	IEEE802.3af(15.4 W) IEEE802.3at (30 W)
PoE Wiring	1/2(+), 3/6(-)
PoE Port Output Voltage	DC 44-57V
PoE Budget	85W
Network Medium	10BASE-T: Cat3, 4, 5 or above UTP(≤100 meters) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100 meters) / 1000BASE-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100 meters)
Optical Medium	multi mode: 50/125, 62.5/125, 100/140um / Single mode: 8/125, 8.7/125, 9/125, 10/125um
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -10℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Surge Protection	Surge protection: common mode 6KV, differential mode 2KV / Electrostatic ESD: air 8KV, contact 6KV
Power	Power Input Voltage: AC100-240V / Internal Power Supply: 52V1.92A
Power Consumption	＜12W
Fan Quantity	0
Installation	Desktop, Rack mounting
LED Indicators	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power on
Off: no power / SYS / On: The system is normal / Flashing: System startup in progress / 1-8 Port green light / On: link connection is normal / Off: Link blocked / Flashing: Data transmitting / 1-8 Yellow Light (PoE) / On: PoE powered on / Off: PoE powered off / 9 Port / Blue Light on: 10G link / Green Light on: 1000/2500Mbps link / Off: Link blocked / Blinking: Data transmitting / Reset / Long press for 6 seconds to restore factory settings
Web Function
Port	Port Switch configuration / Port Speed configuration / Port Duplex configuration / Port Flow Control configuration / EEE / Jumbo Frame
Link Aggregation	Supports load balance policy; Base on MAC and IP-MAC / Static and Dynamic Group / LACP / Up to 8 groups
Storm Control	Broadcast suppression / Unknown Multicast / Unknown Unicast
Port Mirroring	One to one monitor / Many to one monitor / Ingress/Egress/Both / Up to 4 session groups
Port Security	MAC Address Constraints / Protect/Restrict/Shutdown
Port Isolation	Support
Port Rate-limit	Support
VLAN	Access/Trunk/Hybrid / VLAN Tunnel (Q-in-Q Tunnel) / VLAN range 1-4094, maximum active VLAN is 4K
MAC Address	Filtering MAC Address / Static MAC address
Spanning Tree Protocol	STP/RSTP / BPDU Filter / BPDU Guard / Edge Port
LLDP	LLDP / LLDP MED
Multicast	IGMP Snooping / Router Port / Static IGMP Join / IGMP V1/V2
PoE	PoE used power / PoE Type/Level/Power/Voltage/Current / PoE Switch / PoE power AF/AT adaptation
QoS	Traffic classification, supporting SP and WRR scheduling / Port Priority / 802.1P Priority / IP DSCP Priority / Priority Remarking / Supports up to 8 queues per port
ERPS	Main Ring
Services
Access Protocol	HTTP / Session Timeout
Security	DHCP Snooping
Diagnostics
Copper Test	Support
Ping	Support
Equipment Management
Manager Access	HTTP / SNMP
Manager IP	Static Address / Manager VLAN / DNS / DHCP Client
SNMP	V1/V2C / Community / Trap Host
SNMP MIB	RFC 1213 MIB-II / RFC 1643 Ethernet MIB / RFC 2863 Interface MIB
User Management	Support
Firmware Management	Firmware upgrade
Configuration Management	Upload/Backup Configuration
Save	Support
Restart	Support
Factory Defaults	Support
Standard Compliance	IEEE 802.3x flow control and back pressure / IEEE 802.3ad port trunk with LACP / IEEE 802.1D Spanning Tree Protocol / IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol / IEEE 802.1p Class of Service / IEEE 802.1Q VLAN tagging / RFC 768 UDP / RFC 793 TFTP / RFC 791 IP / RFC 792 ICMP / RFC 2068 HTTP / RFC 1112 IGMP v1 / RFC 2236 IGMP v2 / RFC 3376 IGMP v3
Dimension
Remark

Application
Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power adapter(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pair mounting brackets(rack mountable)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 220*161*44.5mm
Inner box size: 315*215*85mm
Product weight: 0.92Kg
Packing weight: 1.23Kg
Master box size: 445*445*335mm
Packing quantity: 10Pcs
Packing weight: 13.3Kg
Remark
Accessories(optical module, patchcord etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Please prepare it by yourself or purchase a whole set from us
Power adapter is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing
